name: pdf-reading
title: pdf-reading
description: Extract text, tables, and structured information from PDF documents using pdfplumber, PyPDF2, or pdftotext command-line tools.

related_skills.name: marker
related_skills.reason: Marker is a narrower PDF-reading tool focused on PDF-to-Markdown conversion preserving formulas and structure; pdf-reading includes broader text/table extraction methods.

related_skills.name: pdf
related_skills.reason: pdf-reading covers extraction only; pdf also creates, merges, splits, fills forms, and broader PDF processing.
